name: impact_analysis
description: BEFORE modifying/renaming: callers (blast radius), callees, risk (caller-count blast). Line-level? call_chain. Simple edit? read_symbol+write_symbol. AUTO-FRESH: files modified after last index are re-indexed automatically on read — explicit reindex only needed for brand-new workspaces/files.

workspace_dir.description: REQUIRED: project root (abs). reindex first if new.

file.description: Path rel to root (not absolute, not a dir)

symbol.description: Symbol to analyze (fn/class/method/var). Omit → file-level. Use symbols[] for batch.

symbols.description: Multiple symbol names to analyze in one call. Returns array of results. Mutually exclusive with symbol.

change_type.description: Change type. Affects risk threshold (default: modify)

max_callers.description: Max callers to return (default: 20). caller_count always includes full counts. Backward-compat alias for max_results.

max_results.description: Y002-S4 output budget: max results to return (default 20, 0=unlimited). max_callers is a backward-compat alias.

context_mode.description: Y002-S4 output budget: caller context granularity. none=no context (cheapest), snippet, full (default).

depth.description: Indirect caller BFS depth (default: 2, max: 10). Only used when symbol is provided.
